name: Rare Beauty draws
tagline_en: Rare Beauty draws inspiration from Greek mythology for globa
desc_en: The Selena Gomez-founded cosmetics brand’s new effort around its second fragrance spans social, out-of-home, retail and paid digital.

name: Dollar General opens
tagline_en: Dollar General opens call for small business vendors
desc_en: The discount retailer is inviting eligible businesses to explore potential partnership opportunities and access training and funding resources.

name: Canada Goose’s journey
tagline_en: Inside Canada Goose’s journey to reconnect with nature
desc_en: Brand platform “Natural Intelligence” spotlights tornado chasers and outdoor adventures to reconnect the brand and its audience to the natural world.

name: Brand licensing firm
tagline_en: Brand licensing firm snaps up DTC intimates brand Cosabella
desc_en: Crown Brands Group also acquired lingerie brand Hanky Panky late last year and aims to buy more companies, including in other categories.

name: Sephora names 12
tagline_en: Sephora names 12 beauty brands to accelerator cohort
desc_en: Now in its 10th year, Sephora Accelerate aims to support the next generation of cosmetic, skin care, hair care and fragrance brands.

name: Modern Retail+ Research:
tagline_en: Modern Retail+ Research: Brands are expanding their creator
desc_en: As brands expand their creator marketing strategies, they are increasingly tapping influencers for more than just awareness campaigns. Many are partnering with creators to help drive seasonal campaigns, support product launches and, in some cases, even help develop products.

name: Brands Briefing: Behind
tagline_en: Brands Briefing: Behind True Religion’s path to $1B, from Ti
desc_en: True Religion hopes doubling its store count and joining TikTok Shop can help power its revenue to $1 billion. Its CEO unpacked the plan with Modern Retail.

name: Unpacked: How agentic
tagline_en: Unpacked: How agentic AI is reshaping the consumer journey
desc_en: This Unpacked guide, sponsored by Talon.One, explores how brands can make their loyalty and promotions agent-ready, as agentic commerce evolves from a theoretical concept into practical applications, and AI agents begin to handle the end-to-end shopping journey for consumers.  Agentic commerce has q

name: Retail brands risk
tagline_en: Retail brands risk optimizing the wrong thing
desc_en: AI platforms are making purchase decisions. Is your brand structured to be found?

name: Gap Inc. opens
tagline_en: Gap Inc. opens creator program to employees
desc_en: Corporate, distribution and store staff can now apply to be influencers for the retailer’s brand portfolio, almost a year after the program’s launch.

name: Schnucks’ new health-tracking
tagline_en: Schnucks’ new health-tracking AI assistant is a model for ot
desc_en: St. Louis-based regional grocer Schnucks just launched a new AI assistant, but behind it is a larger idea around how agents could eventually take over the shopping process and help people eat healthier.

name: the tool guiding
tagline_en: Inside the tool guiding Kenvue’s sustainability-focused prod
desc_en: Kenvue’s in-house profiler uses 1,300 equations to push greener R&D across brands like Tylenol, Neutrogena and Listerine.

name: Warby Parker
tagline_zh: 人人买得起的设计师眼镜
tagline_en: Eyewear for Everyone
desc_zh: Warby Parker是DTC眼镜行业的先驱品牌（NYSE: WRBY）。2025全年净收入8.719亿美元，同比增长13%。2025年首次实现全年净利润（160万美元）。全年新开47家门店，年底拥有323家门店，活跃客户270万。2026年计划再开50家新店，并与Google和三星合作推出AI眼镜。
desc_en: Warby Parker is a pioneering DTC eyewear brand (NYSE: WRBY). FY2025 net revenue $871.9M, up 13% YoY. First full-year net income ($1.6M) in 2025. Opened 47 new stores in 2025, ending with 323 locations and 2.7M active customers. Plans 50 new stores in 2026 and AI glasses partnership with Google and Samsung.

name: Hims & Hers
tagline_zh: 个性化健康与保健解决方案
tagline_en: Health & Wellness, Personalized for You
desc_zh: Hims & Hers是一个远程医疗和健康平台（NYSE: HIMS），提供处方药物和个人护理产品的在线订阅服务。2025全年收入23.48亿美元，同比增长59%。拥有超过250万订阅用户。2025年实现净利润1.284亿美元。2026年收入指引为27-29亿美元。
desc_en: Hims & Hers is a telehealth and wellness platform (NYSE: HIMS) offering prescription medications and personal care products via online subscriptions. FY2025 revenue was $2.348B, up 59% YoY. Over 2.5M subscribers. Net income of $128.4M in 2025. 2026 revenue guidance of $2.7B-$2.9B.
funding: Public company (NYSE: HIMS). FY2025 revenue $2.35B, net income $128.4M

name: Poppi
tagline_zh: 益生元苏打水，美味与健康兼得
tagline_en: Be Gut Happy — Prebiotic Soda
desc_zh: Poppi是一个以苹果醋和益生元为基础的功能性苏打水品牌，每罐含不超过5克糖。2024年年收入超过5亿美元，进入120多家零售商。2025年3月被百事公司以19.5亿美元收购，交易于2025年5月完成。
desc_en: Poppi is a functional soda brand made with apple cider vinegar and prebiotics, with no more than 5g sugar per serving. Annual revenue exceeded $500M in 2024, sold in 120+ retailers. Acquired by PepsiCo for $1.95B in March 2025, deal closed May 2025.

name: Feastables
tagline_en: Snacks by MrBeast
desc_zh: Feastables是YouTube创作者MrBeast（Jimmy Donaldson）创立的零食品牌，以巧克力棒为核心产品。2024年销售额约2.5亿美元，利润超过2000万美元，首次超过其YouTube业务收入。母公司Beast Industries在2024年获得Alpha Wave领投的3亿美元C轮融资，估值约50亿美元。产品已扩展至欧洲、非洲和亚洲。
desc_en: Feastables is a snack brand founded by YouTube creator MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson), centered on chocolate bars. 2024 sales of ~$250M with $20M+ profit, surpassing his YouTube revenue for the first time. Parent company Beast Industries raised $300M Series C led by Alpha Wave at ~$5B valuation. Expanding into Europe, Africa, and Asia.
funding: Parent Beast Industries: $300M Series C at ~$5B valuation (2024). Total raised: $450M+

name: OLIPOP
tagline_zh: 一种新型苏打水——富含益生元，有益肠道健康
tagline_en: A New Kind of Soda — Prebiotic Soda for Gut Health
desc_zh: OLIPOP是一个益生元苏打水品牌，使用植物纤维和益生元配方，每罐含2-5克糖。2024年收入达4亿美元，实现盈利。2025年2月完成5000万美元C轮融资，估值18.5亿美元，由摩根大通成长股权合伙人领投。产品已进入沃尔玛、Target、Costco和Whole Foods等近5万个零售网点。
desc_en: OLIPOP is a prebiotic soda brand using plant fiber and prebiotics, with 2-5g sugar per can. Revenue reached $400M in 2024, achieving profitability. Raised $50M Series C in Feb 2025 at $1.85B valuation led by JP Morgan Growth Equity Partners. Sold in nearly 50,000 retail locations including Walmart, Target, Costco, and Whole Foods.
funding: Series C, $50M at $1.85B valuation (Feb 2025). Total raised: $243M

name: Vuori
tagline_zh: 为追求美好生活而设计的运动服饰
tagline_en: Investment in Happiness — Performance Apparel
desc_zh: Vuori是一个总部位于加州卡尔斯巴德的运动休闲服饰品牌，2015年创立。2024年11月获得由General Atlantic和Stripes领投的8.25亿美元投资，估值达55亿美元。产品覆盖18个国家，计划在2026年前开设超过100家门店，正在向欧洲和亚洲扩张。
desc_en: Vuori is an athleisure apparel brand based in Carlsbad, CA, founded in 2015. Raised $825M in Nov 2024 led by General Atlantic and Stripes, reaching a $5.5B valuation. Serves customers across 18 countries, targeting 100+ stores by 2026 with expansion into Europe and Asia.
funding: Series D, $825M at $5.5B valuation (Nov 2024). Total raised: $1.27B

name: Glossier
tagline_zh: 美妆灵感源于真实生活
tagline_en: Beauty Inspired by Real Life
desc_zh: Glossier是一个以社区驱动的美妆品牌，由Emily Weiss于2014年创立。累计融资2.664亿美元，2021年Series E轮估值18亿美元。近年来进行全渠道转型，进入全美650家丝芙兰门店，并开设了多家独立门店和全球电商。产品每4-6周更新一次。
desc_en: Glossier is a community-driven beauty brand founded by Emily Weiss in 2014. Raised $266.4M total, valued at $1.8B in 2021 Series E. Underwent omnichannel transformation, launching in 650 US Sephora stores, opening standalone stores, and launching global e-commerce. Product cadence of every 4-6 weeks.
funding: Series E, $80M at $1.8B valuation (July 2021). Total raised: $266.4M

name: Athletic Brewing
tagline_zh: 无酒精精酿啤酒，口感绝不妥协
tagline_en: Craft Beer, Without the Alcohol
desc_zh: Athletic Brewing是全球最大的专注于无酒精啤酒的酿酒公司。2024年7月完成由General Atlantic领投的5000万美元融资，估值约8亿美元。2024年美元销售额同比增长超过50%，在美国非酒精啤酒市场占据19%以上份额。产品覆盖5万多个零售商和2.5万个餐饮场所。被Fast Company评为2025年全球最具创新力公司第32名。
desc_en: Athletic Brewing is the world's largest brewing company focused exclusively on non-alcoholic beer. Raised $50M in July 2024 led by General Atlantic at ~$800M valuation. Dollar sales up 50%+ YoY in 2024, holding 19%+ US non-alcoholic beer market share. Sold at 50,000+ retailers and 25,000 on-premise venues. Ranked #32 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2025.
